theme: Membrane transport of metabolic carboxylates and carnitine
core_role: The shared pathways are sodium-coupled SLC13/SLC25-type carriers moving succinate and other TCA-cycle di/tricarboxylates, framed here as one arm of a broader system shuttling fuel intermediates (pyruvate, monocarboxylates, alpha-ketoglutarate, carnitine) across membranes, notably in the kidney proximal tubule.

theme: Homologous recombination repair of DNA double-strand breaks
core_role: The shared pathways frame genome-stability control, checkpoint signalling and resolution of recombination intermediates as the regulatory and end-stage steps of homologous-recombination-based double-strand break and cross-link repair during replication and mitosis.

theme: Glutamate-centred amino acid and organic acid metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are the glutamate/glutamine/2-oxoglutarate nitrogen hub (with proline and aspartate interconversions), serving as the central amino-nitrogen node that feeds glycine, glyoxylate and dicarboxylate metabolism and glutamine/glycine conjugation of xenobiotic acids.

theme: Cohesin-mediated sister chromatid cohesion and its resolution
core_role: The shared pathways frame mitotic cell-cycle progression and negative control of cohesion as the timed release of cohesin-held sister chromatids, within a theme of cohesin loading, establishment, maintenance and separation.

theme: Mitotic centrosome and spindle assembly regulated by Aurora A/PLK1
core_role: The shared pathways are the Aurora A/TPX2 and PLK1 kinase control of centrosome maturation and spindle assembly at mitotic entry, framed as the core of a broader spindle-formation and checkpoint machinery including Ran, NEK kinases and kinetochore signalling.

theme: Early kidney development: intermediate mesoderm, ureteric bud, nephrogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways describe the metanephric mesenchyme side (intermediate mesoderm origin, progenitor maintenance, mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition into tubules), framed as the reciprocal partner of nephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching.

theme: Amino acid catabolism: aromatic, threonine and glycine pathways
core_role: The shared glycine/glyoxylate pathways act as a downstream convergence point where threonine and other amino acid catabolism (alongside phenylalanine/tyrosine breakdown) generate or interconvert glycine.

theme: Metanephric mesenchyme differentiation and kidney size control
core_role: The shared pathways cover nephron progenitor survival, maintenance and mesenchymal-to-epithelial conversion into tubules, framed as the cellular mechanism by which nephron number and kidney size are set and restrained.

theme: Insulin and adipokine control of glucose and lipid metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are insulin sensitivity, adiponectin signalling and glucose import into cells, framed as the output layer of hormonal (insulin/IGF, glucagon/PKA, AMPK) regulation of systemic fuel storage and use.

theme: Leukocyte adhesion and transendothelial migration
core_role: The shared pathways describe neutrophil migration and diapedesis as the endpoint of integrin- and PECAM1-mediated adhesion that also governs T-cell extravasation, polarity and synapse formation.

theme: Kidney organogenesis: ureteric bud branching and nephron patterning
core_role: The shared pathways capture the early inductive events (intermediate mesoderm, ureteric bud elongation and branching, renal vesicle formation) that precede nephron segmentation and collecting duct, loop of Henle and S-shaped body morphogenesis.

theme: MicroRNA biogenesis and post-transcriptional gene silencing
core_role: The shared pathways are specific instances of miRNA control (pre-miRNA processing, miRNA turnover, miRNA repression of particular mRNAs such as CDH1, CDH11, PD-L1), framed as targets and regulation of the general small-RNA silencing machinery.

theme: Amino acid and organic acid catabolism via glycine
core_role: The shared pathways describe threonine and general L-amino acid breakdown converging on glycine and glyoxylate, here extended to alanine metabolism as a related transamination route.

theme: Germinal centre B cell maturation into plasma and memory cells
core_role: The shared pathways denote germinal centre B differentiation with T follicular helper support and plasma cell output, framed within broad B cell identity, activation, co-stimulation (ICOS, CD27) and memory programmes.

theme: M-CSF signalling in macrophage and myeloid differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways are CSF1 receptor and related interleukin receptor signalling driving macrophage proliferation, framed as the cytokine trigger for monocyte, macrophage and dendritic-cell differentiation alongside GM-CSF and G-CSF.

theme: Regulatory T cell-mediated suppression of T cell activation
core_role: The shared pathways describe induction of Tregs and dampening of CD4/CD8 proliferation, IFN-gamma and Th17 commitment, framed as immunosuppression delivered through costimulatory and antigen-presenting cell contact.

theme: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation, pausing and elongation
core_role: The shared pathways describe promoter-proximal Pol II pausing, CTD phosphorylation and early elongation complex formation, framed as the host transcription checkpoint that HIV Tat exploits to drive viral transcription.

theme: Spliceosome assembly and snRNA production for mRNA splicing
core_role: The shared pathways are spliceosome activity and snRNA cap hypermethylation, framed as the snRNP maturation and core splicing step fed by Pol II/III snRNA transcription and tri-snRNP assembly.

theme: Maternal-to-zygotic transition and early embryonic lineage specification
core_role: The shared pathways describe maternal mRNA clearance, zygotic genome activation and first lineage choices (trophectoderm, germ cells, pluripotency), framed as the core of pre-implantation development leading to inner cell mass formation.

theme: AMPA receptor trafficking in excitatory synaptic plasticity
core_role: The shared pathways describe AMPA receptor clustering, diffusion trapping and short-term plasticity at glutamatergic synapses, framed as the synaptic mechanism underlying simple learning.

theme: Cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing and type I interferon antiviral response
core_role: The shared pathways cover IRF3-driven type I IFN induction and its cGAS/STING limits, framed as the output of RIG-I/MDA5 RNA sensing that culminates in OAS and interferon antiviral effects.

theme: RIG-I-like receptor and TLR3 signalling to type I interferon
core_role: The shared pathways describe the full innate antiviral cascade (RLR/TLR3 sensing, TRAF3/6, TBK1/IKKe activation of IRF3/7 and NF-kB, viral evasion), framed as the signalling upstream of ISG15-mediated antiviral effector mechanisms.

theme: Amyloid-beta production, aggregation and clearance
core_role: The shared pathways describe APP processing control, amyloid fibril formation and amyloid-beta clearance, framed here with endosomal trafficking as the compartment where APP and amyloid-beta are handled.

theme: Inositol phosphate and phosphoinositide signalling via PI3K/AKT
core_role: The shared pathways describe nuclear and cytosolic inositol phosphate/pyrophosphate synthesis and oncogenic AKT activation, framed as part of PI3K/AKT/PTEN signalling and its loss of control in cancer.

theme: Wnt/BMP-driven osteoblast differentiation and skeletal development
core_role: The shared pathways describe Wnt control of mesenchymal stem cell expansion and osteoblast proliferation and differentiation, framed as the progenitor-commitment step of bone formation alongside RUNX2, BMP signalling and ossification.

theme: Inflammasome activation and interleukin-1 regulation
core_role: The shared pathways describe restraint of IL-1, IL-12 and Toll-driven inflammatory cytokine production, framed as the negative-control side of NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated IL-1 processing.

theme: RUNX-regulated transcription in myeloid and granulocyte differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways describe RUNX1/2/3 transcriptional programmes, framed as master regulators of myeloid progenitor commitment and granulopoiesis together with G-CSF signalling.

theme: Toll-like receptor signalling to inflammatory cytokine production
core_role: The shared pathways cover TLR3/4-driven production of TNF, IL-6 and IL-8 and its negative control, framed as the output of MyD88/TRIF adaptor, TRAF6/TAK1 and RIP1 signalling, including TRIF-mediated cell death.

theme: Water-soluble vitamin and nutrient metabolism: B1, B2, carnitine, choline
core_role: The shared pathways describe thiamine and riboflavin uptake and metabolism, framed alongside carnitine and choline handling and the flavin-dependent FMO enzymes as related cofactor and nutrient metabolism.

theme: Neural plate patterning and early neural induction
core_role: The shared pathways describe neural plate regionalization and neuroepithelial differentiation, framed as the core of early axial and border patterning that specifies anterior/posterior neural plate and neural crest.

theme: Axon guidance by repulsive and attractive cues
core_role: The shared pathways describe ephrin and Sema3A repulsion with growth cone collapse and fasciculation, framed as the repulsive core of a broader guidance system including Slit/Robo, netrin, L1 and Rho GTPase cytoskeletal control.

theme: Hypoxia and oxidative stress-induced apoptosis regulation
core_role: The shared pathways describe how cells tune responses to hypoxia and oxidative stress and developmental apoptosis, framed as inputs to the mitochondrial intrinsic apoptotic pathway triggered by peroxide or oxygen-glucose deprivation.

theme: B cell development, activation and proliferation
core_role: The shared pathways are generic lymphocyte and naive/memory B cell expression modules, framed as the identity signature underlying B cell differentiation and proliferation.

theme: Protein and lipid glycosylation in the Golgi
core_role: The shared pathways describe N- and O-glycan, sialyl/fucosyl, blood-group and glycosphingolipid synthesis with nucleotide-sugar transport, framed as the general glycosylation machinery that extends to proteoglycan/GAG, dystroglycan and Notch glycosylation and their disorders.

theme: NK and cytotoxic T cell killing and its regulation
core_role: The shared pathways describe granzyme-mediated killing, NK degranulation and MHC class I/Ib antigen presentation that protects targets, framed as the effector and recognition core of NK/CD8 cytotoxicity and its tolerance controls.

theme: Mitotic chromosome organisation by cohesin and condensin
core_role: The shared pathways describe cohesin loading, cohesion establishment and chromatin looping, framed as the cohesion side of chromosome structuring that is complemented by condensin-driven chromosome condensation.

theme: SLC anion and ion transporters and their disorders in mineralization
core_role: The shared pathways describe SLC4 bicarbonate transport and its defects in renal tubular acidosis, framed as part of a wider set of SLC ion transporters (phosphate, calcium exchangers) governing pH and mineralization of tooth enamel and tissues.

theme: Lysosomal glycoconjugate catabolism and amino sugar metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe lysosomal breakdown of gangliosides and glycosides and its storage diseases, framed alongside sialic acid, amino sugar and nucleotide-sugar metabolism that supply and recycle glycan building blocks.

theme: Somitogenesis and segmentation clock
core_role: The shared pathways describe somite formation and segmental compartment patterning (including LFNG clock defects), framed as the core of somite specification, rostrocaudal polarity and axis elongation.

theme: B cell activation and humoral immune differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways describe B cell identity, BCR signalling, proliferation and differentiation, framed as the activation base from which germinal centre, plasma cell and memory B responses with T follicular help arise.

theme: Phospholipid synthesis and membrane lipid translocation
core_role: The shared pathways describe flippase/scramblase movement and transfer of phospholipids between leaflets and membranes, framed as the distribution step for phospholipids (PS, PE, PC, PG, cardiolipin) synthesized and remodeled elsewhere.

theme: Lipoprotein metabolism and intestinal lipid absorption
core_role: The shared pathways describe LDL and HDL particle remodeling, framed as one stage of the lipoprotein life cycle running from dietary lipid absorption and chylomicron/VLDL assembly to lipase action and clearance.

theme: Mitochondrial 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and TCA cycle
core_role: The shared pathways describe the lipoylated PDH, OGDH and OADH complexes feeding the TCA cycle and lysine/glycine degradation, framed as the oxidative core connected to Fe-S cluster maturation, succinate dehydrogenase and ATP synthesis.

theme: Anaphase spindle midzone and cytokinesis
core_role: The shared pathways describe spindle midzone assembly, spindle elongation and kinetochore attachment, framed as the mitotic spindle events that position and drive Rho GTPase-dependent cytokinesis.

theme: Neurotransmitter transport and reuptake at synapses
core_role: The shared pathways describe SLC-mediated vesicular loading and transport of neurotransmitters (including glycine transporter defects), framed as the transport machinery for glutamate, GABA and glycine reuptake and astrocytic recycling.

theme: Stress-induced senescence and p53 damage-response restraint
core_role: The shared pathways describe oxidative stress-induced senescence with suppression of p53-mediated apoptosis and stress kinase signalling, framed as the cell-fate response to UV and DNA damage that favours arrest over death.

theme: Erythrocyte iron, heme and gas transport
core_role: The shared pathways describe red cell and systemic transport of iron, heme, oxygen, CO2 and ammonium (transferrin, ferroportin, Rh proteins) and their anemias, framed as the transport side of erythropoiesis and heme biosynthesis.

theme: Heavy metal and zinc homeostasis and detoxification
core_role: The shared pathways describe cadmium and mercury transport and detoxification, framed as toxic-metal handling through the same zinc transporter, metallothionein and MTF1 machinery that maintains zinc homeostasis.
